jobs.prompt: Game production asset, stylized-concept: a very wide horizontal ground strip for a hand painted 1930s storybook side scrolling game, for a completely burned forest circus camp. The reference is palette/style ONLY. Create ONE seamless horizontally tiling strip of cool gray brown ash, compact earth, charcoal chips, tiny desaturated pebbles, subtle horizontal wheel tracks. Ground reads as a FLAT HORIZONTAL WALKING SURFACE, shallow perspective, not a vertical wall or deep cliff. Upper third a ragged irregular sparse border of small burned twigs, dead grasses and scattered low charred roots; transparent sky above this border. Lower two thirds uninterrupted opaque fine grained ash soil all the way to bottom edge, no foreground trees, no large rocks, no tents, no flames, no lava, no glow, no outlines around the entire ground tile, no text. Broad quiet walking area. Muted blue charcoal and warm gray neutral palette matching reference, restrained detailed painted texture, not photographic. Both left and right cut at same ground level for repeated horizontal placement. Landscape 3:1 transparent background outside ground.

Production game sprite atlas. Use supplied camp artwork only as STYLE AND PALETTE reference. Hand painted dark fairy tale 1930s cartoon background cutouts, fine visible brushwork. Genuine transparent background. 2 by 2 grid of FOUR ISOLATED distinct environment clumps, each inside its own equal rectangular cell with 6 percent clear padding. Top left: tall black carbonized oak trunk with a few broken twisting bare branches and broad gnarled roots, all visible. Top right: tall narrow pair of charred pines with broken bare limbs and rooted bases, all visible. Bottom left: a long LOW tangle of dead burned shrubs, ferns and ash with small rocks, tiny stumps, height much less than width. Bottom right: a LOW horizontal fallen black log among scorched dead grasses and small rocks. No leaves, NO FIRE, no glow, no lava, no characters, no tents, no text, no background scenery, no white border. Colors muted cool blue charcoal bark, gray brown roots, neutral ash. Strong readable silhouettes but gentle shading. Objects stand on bottom center of their own cell, do not overlap other cells. These will be separate parallax planes; trunks must be tall and fully contained. Landscape sheet.

EDIT game asset, preserve reference tent design, warm burgundy red and ivory cloth, small gold diamonds and finials, gentle hand painted cartoon shading. Make a production sprite sheet of EXACTLY TWO MATCHING FRAMES side by side on genuine transparent background, 2 columns, 1 row. Each tent has the SAME OUTER SILHOUETTE, identical size and position in its equal cell, base at same height, full flags and ropes visible with padding. LEFT FRAME: the reference small circus tent CLOSED, centered seam in front red curtain. RIGHT FRAME: exact SAME small tent but center front red curtains drawn back on both sides showing a completely black dark doorway, broad enough for a clown to walk out. Nothing inside opening. Do not change tent scale between frames. No characters, no floor, no background, no glow, no label, no shadows outside canvas silhouette. Do not create a second storey or giant main tent. Landscape sheet.

EDIT AND EXPAND supplied main circus marquee game asset into an ENORMOUS LONG circus big top. Genuine transparent background. Keep the same hand painted burgundy, ivory and gold style, side-facing orientation and dark open doorway on LEFT END. Very wide landscape 3:1 composition. One huge continuous long marquee, multiple tall roof peaks extending far to RIGHT, scalloped golden valances, ropes, standards, stars and diamonds. The OPEN black entrance on the left end is broad, tall and clearly readable, red curtains tied aside; its center is at approximately 16 percent of full image width, with threshold at same ground baseline as all tent walls. The long SIDE WALL extends right across 80 percent of image, clearly side view, not a centered frontal entrance. No secondary door. Full silhouette, all flags and posts inside frame, small transparent margin around object. No landscape, no floor, no people, no creatures, no props in doorway, no text, no glow, no extra storey. A majestic intimidating enemy headquarters. Fine controlled painted shading, no photo realism.
